intro.data: A functor lifts a whole world into another. In the plain world, the Cleaner turns one raw record into a clean one. The Batch world holds MANY records at once. Lift the Cleaner: find the machine that cleans every record in a batch. One does; the other crumples them.
intro.alchemy: A functor lifts a whole world into another. In the plain world, the Smelter refines one ore into an ingot. The Crate world holds many at once. Lift the Smelter: find the machine that refines each ore in a crate. One does; the other crushes them.
intro.spellcraft: A functor lifts a whole world into another. In the plain world, Kindler turns one spark into a flame. The Flock world holds many at once. Lift Kindler: find the machine that kindles each spark in a flock. One does; the other smothers them.
intro.abstract: A functor F lifts each machine into another world. f cleans one thing; build F(f), which does the same job to a whole F(A). The impostor does not.

goal.data: Turn a batch of raw records into a batch of clean records — by lifting the Cleaner.
goal.alchemy: Turn a crate of ore into a crate of ingots — by lifting the Smelter.
goal.spellcraft: Turn a flock of sparks into a flock of flames — by lifting Kindler.
goal.abstract: Take F(A) to F(B) with F(f).

description.data: cleans every record in the batch
description.alchemy: refines every ore in the crate
description.spellcraft: kindles every spark in the flock

afterSuccess.data: You lifted the Cleaner into the Batch world: F(f) cleans every record, doing to a whole batch what f did to one. That assignment — each type A to F(A), each machine f to F(f) — is a functor.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You lifted the Smelter into the Crate world: F(f) refines every ore. Each type A to F(A), each machine f to F(f) — that is a functor.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You lifted Kindler into the Flock world: F(f) kindles every spark. Each essence A to F(A), each rune f to F(f) — that is a functor.
afterSuccess.abstract: You built F(f), the lift of f. Sending each object A to F(A) and each morphism f to F(f) is a functor.

reveal.summary: A functor F : C → D lifts a whole category into another: each object A to F(A), each morphism f : A → B to F(f) : F(A) → F(B) that does the same job in the new world.
reveal.moreFormal: F must also preserve identities and composition (next puzzles). List, Optional, and Batch are all functors: F(A) wraps A, and F(f) = "apply f inside".
reveal.programmerAnalogy: List is a functor: List<A>, and map(f): List<A> => List<B>.
